purpose: Brief for a fictional designer boutique, used to test how far the runner gets when the brief asks for more than the specs describe.

store.name: Alder & Vale
store.sells: Women's designer clothing and accessories from a curated set of brands

rules: Products are samples, labeled as samples in the owner area. Use only the fictional brands listed above.
Each product has a brand, a category, and belongs to one or more collections.
Clothing has sizes (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10) and each size has its own stock. At least four products have one or more sizes sold out.
At least two products are sold out in every size.
Prices between $90 and $1,400, one-of-a-kind items allowed.
Every product has a short description, a Materials & care list and a Specifications list.
No stock or generated photos are fetched or invented.
Products and the hero start without photos and show a neutral placeholder.
The owner adds photos, including the hero banner, through the owner area.

look.accent_note: Choose a restrained accent that suits a fashion boutique and record it.

messages: Take 10% off sale items with code SAMPLE10

header.logo: centered, text wordmark until the owner uploads one
header.left: Women / Men switch (Women is the default; Men may be empty)
header.menu: centered, uppercase, shows the categories plus 'Designers' (the brands page) and 'Sale'

sections_in_order: Hero banner: owner-uploaded image, headline, one button
Brands strip: the brands carried, each linking to that brand's page
Collection sections: one per collection marked show_on_home, with title, description and the first products
Email signup strip: one email field and a button; store the address and show a thank-you message; send nothing
owner_editable: which collections show on home and their order

columns: Customer Service (Help & FAQ, Returns & refunds, Contact us)
Stores & Contact (each store's address and phone)
Explore (About us, Gift cards, Shop all)

sections_in_order: Color and size (sold-out sizes are shown struck through and cannot be chosen)

orders.order_reference: A short, unique, human-readable code shown on the confirmation page. No lookup page and no email in this version.

pickup.at_checkout: A choice between Ship and Pickup; Pickup lets the shopper choose a store and shows its ready time. No shipping charge for pickup.

policies.note: Sample wording until the owner confirms their own.

owner.sign_in: One owner, from environment configuration. The email and password hash are supplied when the store is deployed.
areas: products with brand, categories, collections and per-size stock

storage.photos: A storage adapter: local disk for development, Vercel Blob when deployed

stack: See the Builder's knowledge/stack.json. Those decisions are fixed.

collections.note: Collections group products across categories and appear as sections on the home page. A product can be in several.

items.name: New Arrivals
items.description: The newest pieces for the season.

items.name: Occasion Dressing
items.description: Dresses and finishing touches for celebrations.

items.name: Best Sellers
items.description: What our customers keep coming back for.

not_in_this_version: Shopper accounts, login, 'Your orders' and wishlist
assumptions: All brand names, addresses and phone numbers are fictional samples.
The Women/Men switch only filters by a field on each product.
